sentences.en: By good luck, he was in time for the train.
sentences.zh: 1. 好在运气不错，他赶上了火车。

sentences.en: Is his failure ascribable to incompetence or to bad luck?
sentences.zh: 2. 他的失败是因为能力不足还是因为倒霉？

sentences.en: Our success was due in part to good luck.
sentences.zh: 3. 我们的成功部分要归功于好运气。

senses.zh: 运气；幸运；带来好运的东西
